steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: AO6 Requirement: Use a range of vocabulary and sentence structures for clarity, purpose and effect. Good grammar ensures your writing is clear, professional and achieves its purpose. | Watch out for: Words between subject and verb can confuse agreement. "The box of chocolates is on the table" - the subject is 'box' (singular), not 'chocolates'. | AO6 Tip: Vary your sentence structures for effect. Use simple sentences for impact, complex for detail, compound for flow. | Exam Tip: Using subject terminology accurately shows sophistication in language analysis. Know the difference between nouns, verbs, adjectives and adverbs at minimum.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Identify the error: "The group of students are studying hard." | Rewrite using active voice: "The window was broken by the ball." | What type of sentence is this? "When the rain stopped, the children ran outside."

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on AO6 Requirement, Watch out for, AO6 Tip, and one past-paper question.
